item.title: EMW WCS-X Oscillator Demo – Wavetables, LFOs, AD Generators, PWM modulation & Sync
item.description: video upload by EMW Synthesizers "This video demonstrates the oscillator section of the WCS-X synthesizer, focusing on its waveforms, LFOs, PWM/Wave shaping modulation, Vintage effect character, and Hard Sync behavior. All sounds are generated directly by the WCS-X. The demo highlights the raw tonal character of the oscillators as well as their response to modulation and oscillator interaction."
